slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 暮秋寒风掠过青岚宗后山，卷起林间枯黄落叶，悠悠飘荡。
后山杂役院，是整座宗门最偏僻、最冷清的地界。
这里远离前山殿宇的灵气熏陶，也没有外门弟子居所的规整雅致，只有一排排老旧木屋错落排布。
木梁常年风吹日晒早已腐朽，墙角爬满潮湿青苔，四下里都透着一股荒芜落寞的气息。
院落最边角的位置，孤零零立着一间破败小屋。
墙壁斑驳脱灰，木窗歪斜漏风，屋内陈设简陋到极致，只有一张老旧木板床，一张缺角木桌，再无多余物件。
昏沉之间，木床上的少年缓缓睁开双眼。
眸中先是掠过一丝短暂的茫然，转瞬之后，便被一抹深沉冰冷的沧桑彻底覆盖。
那绝非一个十六岁少年该有的眼神。
沉静，疏离，带着看透人心世故的漠然，还有历经无数厮杀沉淀下来的凛冽寒气。
林宸缓缓坐起身，低头望着自己瘦弱单薄、布满劳作厚茧的手掌。
指尖青涩，体魄孱弱，浑身还残留着被人殴打过的隐隐钝痛。
上一世，他耗时万载苦修，一路修成渡劫巅峰，纵横修真界半生浴血杀伐，最后遭到一众强者联手暗算，不甘而亡。
再度睁眼，神魂重回年少身躯，一切都有了重新来过的机会。
原身便是年少的林宸，身世孤苦，无亲无故，自幼被青岚宗收留，自幼便编入杂役院，每日做着劈柴、扫地、巡山之类的粗重杂活。
从前的他性子懦弱卑微，遇事只懂退让隐忍，从不与人争执半分。
可在弱肉强食的宗门底层，温顺从来换不来善待，只会沦为旁人肆意欺凌的软柿子。
昨日，他只是行路间无心冲撞了内门弟子的随行仆从，便被同院三名蛮横杂役借机围殴。
身受内伤郁结，气血受损，险些就此丧命，也恰好让陨落的自身神魂，重回这具年少身躯。
林宸眼底掠过一抹淡淡的寒芒。
行走修真界多年，他早已看透世间人情冷暖，宗门倾轧，同门算计更是司空见惯。
心软者难以立足，忍让者无路可走。
一味卑微讨好，换不来半分怜悯，只会让人得寸进尺，肆意践踏尊严。
从前那个逆来顺受、任人拿捏的懦弱少年，已经彻底消失。
从今往后，活在这具身躯里的，是历经百战、杀伐果断、利己冷血，从不心慈手软的修行者林宸。
他安静坐在床沿，缓缓调匀体内气息，适应着这具肉身的孱弱状态。
下意识凝神内视，探查自身根底之时，一丝隐晦奇特的气息，悄然从血肉筋骨深处弥散开来。
气息内敛深沉，不带半点张扬，被周身俗世凡尘浊气层层遮掩，寻常修士根本无从察觉。
唯有他这种阅历深厚的过来人，一眼便能洞悉本质。
这是寂灭道体。
天生自带特殊禀赋，肉身坚韧远超常人，吸纳天地灵气的亲和度得天独厚，修行起步便甩开普通凡躯一大截。
只是如今道体被凡尘浊气禁锢，潜能蒙尘不显，只能暗自潜藏体内，无法轻易展露锋芒。
林宸面色平静，心中不起丝毫波澜。
身负无上道体，重回年少岁月，起点看似卑微到尘埃，实则早已立于不败之地。
但他深谙木秀于林的道理。
眼下身在杂役底层，修为浅薄，无权无势，一旦太过张扬，只会引来无端觊觎与祸端。
不如暂且蛰伏隐忍，一边静养身上暗伤，一边默默吸纳灵气打磨根基。
循序渐进洗褪体内凡尘浊气，慢慢唤醒寂灭道体的本源之力，待到自身实力足够，再伺机挣脱杂役院的束缚，一步步踏上崛起之路。
他不愿急于求成，修行之道，根基永远最重要。
走过漫长修行路的他，比任何人都懂得稳扎稳打的道理。
content_en:
The cold wind of late autumn passed through the back mountain of Qinglan Sect, picking up the yellow and fallen leaves in the forest and drifting leisurely.
The Back Mountain Miscellaneous Courtyard is the most remote and deserted place in the entire sect.
This place is far away from the spiritual influence of the palace on the front mountain, and it does not have the orderliness and elegance of the outer disciples' residences. There are only rows of old wooden houses scattered here and there.
The wooden beams have long since rotted due to exposure to wind and sun, and the corners of the walls are covered with damp moss. There is an air of desolation and loneliness everywhere.
At the very corner of the courtyard, there stood a shabby hut.
The walls are mottled and dusty, the wooden windows are crooked and leaking, and the furnishings in the house are extremely simple. There is only an old wooden bed, a wooden table with a missing corner, and no extra items.
In a daze, the young man on the wooden bed slowly opened his eyes.
There was a brief moment of confusion in his eyes, and a moment later, they were completely covered by a deep and cold look of vicissitudes of life.
That was definitely not the look a sixteen-year-old boy should have.
Quiet, alienated, with an indifference that can see through people's sophistication, and a biting coldness that has accumulated through countless battles.
Lin Chen slowly sat up and looked down at his thin, thin palms covered with thick calluses from work.
His fingertips were green, his body was weak, and his whole body still had the dull pain from being beaten.
In his last life, he spent tens of thousands of years practicing hard, reaching the peak of transcending tribulations, and spent half his life fighting bloody battles in the world of cultivation. In the end, he was plotted by a group of powerful men, and he died unwillingly.
When he opened his eyes again, his soul returned to his young body, he had a chance to start over again.
He turned out to be the young Lin Chen, who was born alone and had no relatives. He was taken in by the Qinglan Sect since he was a child. He was assigned to the labor camp since he was a child, doing menial chores such as chopping firewood, sweeping the floor, and patrolling the mountains every day.
In the past, he had a cowardly and humble temperament. He only knew how to give in and tolerate when things happened, and he never argued with others.
But at the bottom of the sect, where the jungle prevails, meekness can never be exchanged for kindness, and it will only become a soft persimmon for others to bully wantonly.
Yesterday, he accidentally bumped into a servant of an inner disciple while walking, and was beaten by three arrogant servants from the same courtyard.
Suffering from internal injuries and stagnation, his vitality and blood were damaged, and he almost died. This also happened to allow his fallen soul to return to this young body.
A faint cold light flashed across Lin Chen's eyes.
Having been walking in the world of cultivation for many years, he has already seen through the warmth and warmth of human beings in the world. It is common for sects to be at odds with each other and plotting against fellow sects.
Those who are soft-hearted will find it difficult to gain a foothold, and those who are patient will have no way out.
Blindly being humble and trying to please will not bring you any mercy. It will only make people push forward and trample on their dignity wantonly.
The cowardly boy who was submissive and allowed others to manipulate him has completely disappeared.
From now on, living in this body is Lin Chen, a practitioner who has experienced hundreds of battles, is decisive in killing, self-interested and cold-blooded, and never shows mercy.
He sat quietly on the edge of the bed, slowly adjusting the breath in his body and adapting to the frail state of this physical body.
When he subconsciously looked inwards and explored his own foundation, a mysterious and strange aura quietly spread from the depths of his flesh and bones.
The breath is restrained and deep, without any ostentation. It is covered by layers of turbid air from the world around him, making it impossible for ordinary monks to detect it.
Only someone with deep experience like him can understand the essence at a glance.
This is the body of Nirvana.
He was born with special talents, his physical body is far tougher than ordinary people, and he has a unique affinity for absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. From the beginning of his practice, he is far beyond the ordinary body.
It's just that now the Tao body is imprisoned by the turbid air of the mortal world, and its potential is hidden in the dust. It can only be hidden in the body secretly, and cannot easily show its edge.
Lin Chen's face was calm, and his heart was not disturbed at all.
Carrying the supreme Taoist body, he returned to his youth. His starting point seemed as humble as dust, but in fact he was already in an invincible position.
But he is well aware of the principle of beauty in the forest.
Currently, he is at the bottom of the labor force, with a shallow cultivation base and no power. If he becomes too public, it will only attract unwarranted covetousness and trouble.
It is better to hibernate and endure for the time being, while quietly recuperating the hidden wounds on the body, while silently absorbing the spiritual energy and polishing the foundation.
Step by step, the mundane turbidity in the body is washed away, and the original power of the dead body is slowly awakened. When one's own strength is sufficient, he will wait for an opportunity to break away from the shackles of the courtyard and embark on the road to rise step by step.
He does not want to rush for success. The foundation of cultivation is always the most important.
Having gone through a long journey of spiritual practice, he knows better than anyone else the principle of steady and steady progress.
